title: Cheesy Tex-Mex Skillet with Veggie Ground, Vegetable Noodles & Yogurt

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and carrots; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the veggie noodles and set aside.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, garlic, veggie ground, and spices. Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate cheddar and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

When the veggie ground is done, add veggie noodles, bell pepper, and water to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has evaporated and veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
When the veggies are tender, add tomato and tomato sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat and sprinkle with cheddar.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls and top with a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!
